## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0, T = 1.2 K: electron n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6, 0 → 10 T, 10 mT above 1 T) and hole n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7, 10 → 0.3 T, 20 mT)

Raw first (left column), then the `sdh_onset` per-tone tracks and the FFT stability sweep (middle), and the B-window split (right). Channel arithmetic R = (sr1_X/1)/(sr0_X/−1e6); both runs at sr1 50 µV (5.05 kΩ full scale), peaks reached 10.5 % (run 6) / 11.6 % (run 7) of full scale — no rail; leakage flat (TG/BG medians within the ±100 pA flyback-noise band); T_sample 1.17–1.29 K.

**Run 6 (electron, F_L = 33.1 T):** strong, highly non-sinusoidal oscillations from ≲ 1 T; a ~7.1–7.5 T fundamental carries a comb at **exact** 2×/3×/4× (14.9, 22.4, 29.9 T, cut 1.3 T; `sdh_onset` flags all three as harmonics of 7.1 T, with per-tone onsets 1.36–1.91 T). No resolved tone at F_L = 33.1 T itself. The light-tone onset is **censored** at the record's low edge (0.30 T) — but the 0–1 T leg was sampled at 50 mT, which under-samples a 7 T tone below ~1 T, so the true onset is < ~1 T and otherwise unmeasured. Above 7.5 T the trace rises to a ~500 Ω plateau-like bump (8–9.5 T) that the polynomial background does not absorb — the [4, 10] T window's spectrum is not trustworthy on its own. **Two readings survive on this one density, and they cannot be separated at a single n:** (a) a *single* 7.5 T pocket with a harmonic comb — a pocket carrying only 0.72×10¹² (g = 4), i.e. a factor 4.4 below the gated density; or (b) the ABAB template at global scale ≈ 0.90: light 7.47 + heavy 22.41 = **29.88 T = F_L·0.90**, partition 0.25 / 0.75 (model at n = +3.2: 7.3 / 25.8 T, ratio 3.5; observed ratio 3.00 — the investigation's explicit warning that a ratio-only harmonic screen eats the real heavy tone when the ABAB ratio drifts through 3×), with the 29.9 T tone the symmetry-allowed inter-block breakdown sum. The discriminator is the **n-dependence**: a harmonic tracks k·f(n) exactly; an ABAB heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve (model: 17.1 T at n = 2 vs 3×3.55 = 10.7 T) and runs to F_L as the light pocket empties near n ≈ 0.8–1.0. That is the Landau fan's job (Step 4).

**Run 7 (hole, F_L = 12.4 T):** cleaner sinusoidal record; onset 0.71 T; dominant tones at **6.2–7.0 T** and **12.4 T = F_L** (cut 1.2–1.7 T; the F_L tone strengthens relative to the ~6.5 T tone in the high-B half — the breakdown/sum-tone signature, weak in a 12 T window), plus a weaker ~4.7–5.3 T component. Model at n = −1.2: ABAB pair 5.9 / 6.5 T (close, balanced — the stated near-CNP exception regime), ABCA 12.4 T with m\* ≈ 1.1 mₑ (LK-dead at this rig's T_e ≈ 8 K, so an ABCA singleton could not have produced a strong 12.4 T tone here — that alone leans the F_L tone toward a sum tone). Hole side reaches only |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² (TG limit) — the low-|n| exception regime; **not the side for the fan**.

**Take:** the electron side is the decisive side (|n| up to 3.2×10¹², onset < 1 T, SNR 40–90 on the fundamental). Handed to the fan: light-tone onset < 1 T (unmeasured below), the ≥ 22 T content onsets at ≥ 1.36 T, fastest content in the claim band ≤ F_L(3.2) = 33 T with only weak 45/60 T harmonics (5–7 %), settling floor 3 s = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, sensitivity 50 µV gave ≤ 12 % of range at |n| ≥ 1.2.

"""sdh-spot-check read, runs 6 (electron, n = +3.2e12) and 7 (hole, n = -1.2e12), D = 0, T = 1.2 K:
raw Rxx(B) first, then sdh_onset per-tone tracks, FFT stability sweep (cutoff x bg_degree), B-window split."""
import warnings
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

h_4e = cst.h / (4 * cst.e)   # T per m^-2
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(17, 8))
spot = {}
for row, (rid, n12) in enumerate([(6, 3.2), (7, -1.2)]):
    r = run(rid); print(f"===== run {rid} =====\n{summarize_run(r)}")
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / -1e6; R = r.col("sr1_X") / 1.0 / I     # channel arithmetic per device card
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    Ib = float(np.nanmedian(I)); fs_R = 50e-6 / abs(Ib)                                 # sr1 sens 50 uV both runs
    FL = h_4e * abs(n12) * 1e16
    print(f"I_bias {Ib*1e9:.2f} nA; R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm (max {np.abs(R).max()/fs_R:.1%} of the {fs_R:.0f} Ohm full scale); "
          f"T_sample {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K; F_L(g=4) = {FL:.2f} T")
    ax = axes[row, 0]; ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("Rxx sr1 (Ohm)")
    ax.set_title(f"run {rid} raw: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0, F_L = {FL:.1f} T")
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        try:
            on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=fs_R); print(on.summary()); onset = on.onset_b
        except SdhOnsetError as e:
            print("SdhOnsetError:", e); onset = 1.0
        for ww in w: print("WARN:", ww.message)
    bmax = float(B.max()); cut0 = max(onset, float(B.min()) + 0.05)
    ax = axes[row, 1]
    for cut, deg in [(cut0, 5), (cut0 + 0.5, 5), (cut0 + 1.0, 5), (2.0, 5), (cut0, 3), (cut0, 7)]:
        f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cut, bmax), bg_degree=deg, log=False, nfft=8192); s = s[0] / s[0].max()
        ax.plot(f, s, lw=0.8, label=f"cut {cut:.2f} T, deg {deg}")
        pk = f[(s > 0.15) & np.r_[True, s[1:] > s[:-1]] & np.r_[s[:-1] > s[1:], True]]
        print(f"  FFT [{cut:.2f}, {bmax:.0f}] T deg {deg}: peaks > 15 % at {np.round(pk[pk < 2 * FL], 2)} T   (dF = {1/(1/cut - 1/bmax):.2f} T)")
    for k, lab in [(1, "F_L"), (0.72, "0.72 F_L"), (0.28, "0.28 F_L")]:
        ax.axvline(k * FL, color="k", ls=":", lw=0.8); ax.text(k * FL, 0.97, lab, rotation=90, fontsize=7, va="top")
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1.6 * FL); ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.set_title("FFT in 1/B (norm.) — stability sweep"); ax.legend(fontsize=6)
    ax = axes[row, 2]; mid = 2 / (1 / cut0 + 1 / bmax)
    for a, b, lab in [(cut0, mid, "low-B half"), (mid, bmax, "high-B half")]:
        f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(a, b), bg_degree=5, log=False, nfft=8192); s = s[0] / s[0].max()
        ax.plot(f, s, lw=0.8, label=f"{lab} [{a:.2f}, {b:.2f}] T")
    for k in (1, 0.72, 0.28): ax.axvline(k * FL, color="k", ls=":", lw=0.8)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1.6 * FL); ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.set_title("B-window split (1/B midpoint)"); ax.legend(fontsize=6)
    spot[rid] = dict(FL=FL, onset=onset, fs_R=fs_R)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`), D = 0, n = +3.2 → +1.0×10¹², B 0.5 → 10 T uniform-1/B

> **05:29** · landau-fan-vti e-side: D=0, n=+3.2->+1.0e12 (56 pts, dn 0.04) fast; B 0.5->10 T slow uniform-1/B (128 rows: 0.5-1.4 T d(1/B) 0.020, 1.4-10 T 0.00975); fast\_delay 1.0 slow\_delay 3; sr1 100 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~09:29** (≈4h)

**Why this fan (spot checks, ana cells 14–15):** run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T) carries a 7.47 T fundamental with an exact 2×/3×/4× comb (14.9 / 22.4 / 29.9 T) and nothing resolved at F_L. Two readings survive at one density and cannot be split there: a single 7.5 T pocket + harmonics, or the ABAB template at global scale 0.90 — light 7.47 + heavy 22.41 = 29.88 T (partition 0.25 / 0.75; model at +3.2: 7.3 / 25.8 T) with the 29.9 T sum tone the symmetry-allowed inter-block breakdown. **Only the n-dependence separates them**: a harmonic tracks 3·f_light(n) exactly (model 3×3.55 = 10.7 T at n = 2), an ABAB heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve (17.1 T at n = 2) and runs to F_L as the light pocket empties (n ≈ 0.8–1.0: model 0.6 / 9.8 T); ABCA would be one tone at F_L(n) everywhere. The hole side reaches only |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² (the investigation's low-|n| exception regime; run 7 shows a strong tone *at* F_L = 12.4 T plus ~6.5 T — consistent with a close ABAB hole pair + sum tone, not decisive), so the fan goes on the electron side. Region B (mosaic, +0.43×10¹² relative to A) adds tones at ×1.13–1.4 in n — read per column, checked against the same F_L.

**Design (Step 2 numbers, computed):** fast axis 56 paired (V_tg, V_bg) points along D = 0 from n = 3.2 → 1.0 (δn = 0.04×10¹²; ≥ 2 points per LL ray for a full-density pocket down to 0.83 T and for a 0.25·n pocket down to 0.2 T — the ≥ 22 T content onsets at ≥ 1.36 T in run 6, so the n-Nyquist floor for it is met with margin). Slow axis uniform in 1/B in **two segments**: 0.5 → 1.4 T at Δ(1/B) = 0.020 T⁻¹ (65 rows; Nyquist 25 T — below 1.4 T only the ≤ 7.5 T light tone is above onset), then 1.4 → 10 T at Δ(1/B) = 0.00975 T⁻¹ (63 more rows; Nyquist 51 T = ⅓-Nyquist on F_L(3.2) = 33 T; run 6's only content above 34 T is 45/60 T harmonics at 5–7 %, which fold to 41–56 T, outside the claim band). **128 rows × 56 = 7168 points.** Resolution: δF = 1/(1/0.5 − 1/10) = 0.53 T for the light tone, 1/(1/1.4 − 0.1) = 1.63 T for the ≥ 22 T tones — the 22.4-vs-25.8 T (3×light vs ABAB heavy) split at n = 3.2 is 2.1·δF, and the split grows to > 6 T by n = 2. B_lo = 0.5 T is set by the light tone at the low-n edge (model 2 T at n = 1.5 → 3.8 periods; `sdh_onset` on run 6 reports the light tone censored at the record edge, i.e. onset < 1 T, with the 0–1 T leg under-sampled at 50 mT). Sensitivity fixed at **100 µV = 10 kΩ FS**: the worst corner (n = 1.0 × 10 T; R(B = 0) = 117 Ω from run 5, QH-regime Rxx maxima 0.5–0.6 kΩ at |n| = 1.2–3.2 in runs 6/7) is expected ≈ 1 kΩ → ≥ 5× headroom, at the price of 2× coarser resolution at the ~10 Ω high-n low-B corner (run 6 had SNR 40–90 there at 5 kΩ FS). Dwell: fast_delay 1.0 s (run 5 calibration 1.17 s/pt all-in; τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB → group delay ≈ 1 column = 0.04×10¹² uniform n-lag, same for every row, so F(n) columns are self-consistent), slow_delay 3 s over the flyback transient; each B step blocks through the ramp + 3 s driver settle.

**Price:** grid 7168 × 1.17 s = 2.3 h + bare traverse 9.5 T / 0.137 T/min = 69 min + 128 rows × ~7 s (settle + slow_delay + flyback) = 15 min → 3.7 h nominal, **≈ 4 h realistic**, ending at **10 T** with the gates at the n = 3.2 point (next step — the LK mass split or the ride-down — starts there; no re-traverse). **Checkpoints:** first rows (~10 min: signal levels vs run 6 at n = 3.2, rail counter, leakage, B readback tracking setpoints) → abort if railed/flat; at ~1.4 T (end of the low segment, ~1.5 h): per-column FFT of the landed rows — does the light tone's F scale with n? — continue/adjust; at ~4 T (~2.7 h): heavy-tone F(n) on the landed 1.4–4 T record (δF ≈ 2.2 T) vs 3×f_light(n). Cheap kills only in the first two; the last is an interim read.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`): electron side, D = 0, n = +3.2 -> +1.0e12 (fast, paired n-line), B 0.5 -> 10 T slow (uniform in 1/B, two segments) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
D0 = 0.0
n_hi, n_lo, N_n = 3.2, 1.0, 56                       # 1e12 cm^-2; dn = 0.04e12 (>= 2 pts/ray for a full-density pocket down to 0.83 T, for a 0.25-n pocket down to 0.2 T)
ns = np.linspace(n_hi, n_lo, N_n)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, D0 * np.ones_like(ns), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs, float), np.asarray(Vbgs, float)
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"fast axis: n = {n_hi:+.2f} -> {n_lo:+.2f}e12 ({N_n} pts, dn {abs(ns[1]-ns[0]):.3f}e12) at D = {D0:+.2f}; "
      f"Vtg {Vtgs.min():+.4f}..{Vtgs.max():+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs.min():+.4f}..{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V (validators TG [{TG_MIN},{TG_MAX}] BG [{BG_MIN},{BG_MAX}])")

# --- slow axis: uniform in 1/B. Low segment 0.5 -> 1.4 T at d(1/B) = 0.020 /T (Nyquist 25 T: only the <= 7.5 T light tone is
#     above onset there, run 6); high segment 1.4 -> 10 T at d(1/B) = 0.00975 /T (Nyquist 51 T = 1/3-Nyquist on F_L(3.2) = 33 T).
B_lo, B_mid, B_hi = 0.5, 1.4, 10.0
N1 = int(round((1 / B_lo - 1 / B_mid) / 0.020)) + 1          # 65
N2 = int(np.ceil((1 / B_mid - 1 / B_hi) / 0.0099)) + 1       # 64
seg1 = 1.0 / np.linspace(1 / B_lo, 1 / B_mid, N1)
seg2 = 1.0 / np.linspace(1 / B_mid, 1 / B_hi, N2)
B_vec = np.round(np.hstack((seg1, seg2[1:])), 5)
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
d1 = np.diff(1 / B_vec)
print(f"slow axis: {len(B_vec)} rows, B {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T; d(1/B) low {abs(d1[:N1-1]).mean():.4f}, high {abs(d1[N1:]).mean():.5f} /T "
      f"(Nyquist {1/(2*abs(d1[N1:]).mean()):.1f} T vs F_L(n_hi) = {abs(n_hi)*1e16*6.626e-34/(4*1.602e-19):.1f} T); largest B step {np.diff(B_vec).max()*1e3:.0f} mT")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vap = {T_vaporizer():.3f} K, B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05: fan starts by ramping 0 -> 0.5 T), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci tg/bg {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert int(heater.sample_range()) == 0 and int(heater.vaporizer_range()) == 0, "heaters not off"
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0      # run-5 calibration: 1.17 s/pt all-in at fast_delay 1.0; slow_delay covers the gate flyback transient
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Worst corner is n = 1.0 x 10 T: R(B=0) = 117 Ohm (run 5),
# QH-regime Rxx maxima ~0.5-0.6 kOhm at |n| ~ 1.2-3.2 (runs 6/7) -> ~1 kOhm expected, >= 5x headroom; costs 2x resolution at the 10-Ohm high-n low-B corner.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron side: D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm, n = {n_hi:+.2f} -> {n_lo:+.2f}e12 ({N_n} pts) fast, "
                  f"B {B_vec[0]:.2f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.1f} T slow uniform-1/B ({len(B_vec)} rows: 0.5-1.4 T d(1/B) 0.020, 1.4-10 T 0.00975), "
                  f"fast_delay {FAST_DELAY}, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY}, sr1 100 uV; cal run 5")
